metadata.description: Small, verifiable tools for shipping things: check what you released is what people actually receive.

plugins.name: ship-check
plugins.description: Verify a deploy actually landed and the page actually renders. Catches the 200 that shows nothing, broken links, staging that never updated, and the bugs that only appear from a clean install.

plugins.name: agent-craft
plugins.description: Four methods for building AI agent systems that hold up: make a small model behave like a big one, gate every change through eight checks, borrow a consumer GPU from a CPU server, and hand a large repo to the next agent without losing the map.
